digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must be configured to resolve LLM model classes to Bedrock inference profiles via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE layered config instead of the deprecated REBAR_LLM_MODEL bare variable
All gate runs against Bedrock must be provider-clean with 100% of LLM calls routed to Bedrock inference profiles and zero direct Anthropic API calls
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path with nonzero cache_read_tokens observed across gate runs, not only cache_write_tokens
Bedrock cachePoint defaults to 5-minute TTL matching Anthropic cache_control default, resulting in no observable functional difference in cache behavior
Configuration opt-in and single-step revert (unset REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE) must be documented in docs/local-dev-env.md and verified executable
No changes to infra/ directory are permitted; the scope is local configuration and documentation only
